    cw = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    # Tile intervals are bounded by the repeated uniform separator rows/columns.
    rstep = min((b-a for a,b in zip(rh, rh[1:])), default=1)
    cstep = min((b-a for a,b in zip(cw, cw[1:])), default=1)

    # Colored marks on separator lines identify output cells at their grid position.
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[r][0] for c in range(w))]
    for r in sep_rows:

            if v != grid[r][0]:

        vals = {}

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    def get_lines(horizontal):
        n = h if horizontal else w
        span = w if horizontal else h
        lines = []
        for i in range(n):
            vals = grid[i] if horizontal else [grid[r][i] for r in range(h)]
            color = max(set(vals), key=vals.count)
            if vals.count(color) >= span - 2:
                lines.append((i, color))
        return lines

    rows = get_lines(True)
    cols = get_lines(False)

    def regularize(lines):
        if len(lines) < 2:
            return lines
        positions = [p for p, _ in lines]
        gaps = [b-a for a, b in zip(positions, positions[1:])]
        step = max(set(gaps), key=lambda g: (gaps.count(g), g))
        origin = positions[0]
        return [(p, c) for p, c in lines if (p-origin) % step == 0]

    rows = regularize(rows)
    cols = regularize(cols)
    rpos = [p for p, _ in rows]
    cpos = [p for p, _ in cols]
    if not rpos or not cpos:
        return [[0]]

    def gap(lines, default):
        ps = [p for p, _ in lines]
        ds = [b-a for a, b in zip(ps, ps[1:])]
        return max(set(ds), key=lambda x: (ds.count(x), x)) if ds else default

    rs, cs = gap(rows, 1), gap(cols, 1)
    nr = max(1, (h - 1 - rpos[0]) // rs)
    nc = max(1, (w - 1 - cpos[0]) // cs)

    line_r, line_c = set(rpos), set(cpos)
    freq = {}
    for r in range(h):
        if r in line_r:
            continue
        for c in range(w):
            if c not in line_c:
                v = grid[r][c]
                freq[v] = freq.get(v, 0) + 1
    bg = max(freq, key=freq.get) if freq else 0
    out = [[bg for _ in range(nc)] for _ in range(nr)]

    for i, (r, rc) in enumerate(rows):
        oi = min(nr - 1, max(0, round((r-rpos[0]) / rs)))
        for j, (c, cc) in enumerate(cols):
            oj = min(nc - 1, max(0, round((c-cpos[0]) / cs)))
            v = grid[r][c]
            if v != rc and v != cc:
                out[oi][oj] = v
    return out
